evidence.notes: Local Database.getDeleted returns records deleted inside the requested sync window.
GetDeletedResult exposes matching local deleted records.
DeletedRecord exposes the deleted local record Id.
DeletedRecord exposes the deleted local record Id.
DeletedRecord exposes the local deletion Date.
DeletedRecord exposes the local deletion Date.

source.content: Datetime windowStart = Datetime.now().addMinutes(-1); Account account = new Account(Name = 'Delete Me'); insert account; Id accountId = account.Id; delete account; Datetime windowEnd = Datetime.now().addMinutes(1); System.Database.GetDeletedResult observed = System.Database.getDeleted('Account', windowStart, windowEnd); System.assertEquals(1, observed.getDeletedRecords().size()); System.Database.DeletedRecord systemDeleted = observed.getDeletedRecords()[0]; Database.DeletedRecord deleted = observed.getDeletedRecords()[0]; System.assertEquals(accountId, systemDeleted.getId()); System.assertEquals(accountId, deleted.getId()); Date expectedDate = Date.today(); System.assertEquals(expectedDate, systemDeleted.getDeletedDate()); System.assertEquals(expectedDate, deleted.getDeletedDate()); System.assertEquals(expectedDate, observed.getEarliestDateAvailable()); System.assertEquals(expectedDate, observed.getLatestDateCovered());
